verdict.rationale: Employees have their own 'My Equity' view listing their grants, showing which options are exercisable, and letting them exercise and sign documents in-platform. That covers the portal and grant-visibility core. The documented scenario modeling is company-side round and investor-return modeling, not employee-facing outcome modeling. Missing for 10: explicit vesting-progress display, strike price shown in the employee view, employee-facing modeling of equity value under different exit outcomes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
